changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led GTM strategy, launch, and Sales composition with source-bound signals and reviewed pipeline outcomes.

title: Launch to Qualified Pipeline
description: Take an approved B2B offer from a sourced launch brief through observed campaign and lead signals to reviewed qualification and pipeline outcomes.
setup_prompt: Use Launch to Qualified Pipeline as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing GTM, Website Growth, and Sales Crews, the offer and approved claims, site and channel assets, campaign and lead sources, contact policy, CRM stages, meeting source, and budget. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact artifact validators, owner approvals, a manual first route, and a baseline or baseline-first metric. Reuse Inbound Lead-to-Meeting Review for qualification, reviewed follow-up, provider-confirmed delivery, and observed meeting outcomes. Show the plan and wait for my review before Builder applies it. Selection alone does not publish, spend, contact a lead, create Crews, or activate recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Offer version, approved claims, target buyer and market
Website, launch assets, approved channels and budget bounds
Qualified lead, contact, attribution and meeting rules
Authorized campaign, form, CRM and calendar sources or exports
GTM, launch, and Sales review owners
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated event and cadence

pulse_focus.label: Launch to qualified pipeline
focus_areas: Whether approved launch work reaches the intended buyer and yields source-linked enquiries
Whether observed enquiries become policy-qualified pipeline without duplicate or blocked contact
review_when: A launch asset ships, a lead source changes, a qualified lead appears, or the measured baseline becomes comparable

outputs: Reviewed GTM and Sales Crew roster and source map
Validated GTM launch brief and launch-signal register
Lead qualification through the existing Sales Playbook contract
Owner-reviewed follow-up and provider-confirmed outcomes when authorized
Manual run, action ledger, and activation choice
